subject: Priv VPC segmentation + CI gating — merge window & rollforward plan
messages:
From: Sabrina Cole <sabrina.cole@acmecloud.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@acmecloud.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VPC segmentation + CI evidence for private deploy

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the booth chat at the summit. Weʼre getting ready to onboard Redwood into our private VPC (on-prem colo) and the security team asked for a short runbook and the Terraform/Helm artifacts youʼll require for the segmentation change. They also need a small CI gating checklist and the types of evidence we should expect to receive for a SOC2 readiness review.

Concretely:
- We plan to create a dedicated subnet pair + routing rules for Redwood worker pools.
- We want a non-disruptive merge with the existing network (have canary subnets).
- SOC2 team wants to confirm deployment drift detection and artifact provenance.

Can you share the minimum Terraform module changes we should expect, any Helm values that must be pinned, and a short list of evidence artifacts (logs, signed manifests, CI run ids) that satisfy your internal gating? Weʼd like to schedule a 30m call this week to sync.

Attaching the current VPC diagram and a bundle of SOC evidence we have for prior vendors.

Thanks,
Sabrina Cole
Platform Security Lead, AcmeCloud
Sabrina.Cole@acmecloud.com

Attachment: acme_priv_vpc_diagram.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: acme-soc2-evidence.zip (zip)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: Sabrina Cole <sabrina.cole@acmecloud.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VPC segmentation + CI evidence for private deploy

Sabrina — thanks for the context and the attachments. Short answer: we can support the subnet pair + canary approach and provide a reproducible IaC bundle and CI evidence that maps directly to the deployment used in production. High level plan below; Iʼll own the coordination.

Plan (summary):
1) Terraform: we will provide a lightweight terraform module (redwood/priv-network) that declares the worker subnets, routing tables, and security-group interface. The module will accept a parameter for canary_subnet_ids and a flag (non_destructive=true) that controls a staged rollout.
2) Helm: we will publish a values overlay (values.priv.yaml) with explicit imageDigest pins and sidecar egress rules. We require certain annotations for our KV-cache and metrics hooks — Iʼll include a sample values file.
3) CI gating: our GitHub PR -> GitLab CI job will: run terraform plan (store plan artifact), run terratest subset for seg tests, run helm template & diff against base manifests, and publish a signed artifact (sha256 + key id). CI runs and artifacts will be referenced in the gating checklist.
4) Evidence: Terraform plan artifact, CI run id, signed manifest (manifest.sig), and provenance metadata (git sha, build id, key id). For SOC2 auditors we include a short attestation doc signed by our infra lead.

Immediate asks for your team:
- Confirm the canary subnets (ids) you want Redwood to target for the first deploy.
- Confirm whether your egress NACLS require any additional ports for our health/metrics endpoints (default: 443 outbound + 5222 for internal control plane).
- Point us to the CI runner credentials we can use to push artifacts (or we can push signed artifacts to a joint S3 with ACLs).

Iʼll loop in Laura and Vivek for CI and networking specifics; we should be able to provide a draft repo in 48 hours. Would Tuesday 10:30am PT work for a 30m?

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: terraform-plan-segmentation.diff (txt)
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VPC segmentation + CI evidence for private deploy

Adding CI and operational constraints here. Quick notes for the runbook weʼll produce:

- GitOps & merge window: we require a merge window with a canary promotion step. PRs must include a terraform plan artifact (we'll fail the merge if plan changes touch routing tables outside allowed ranges).
- Rollback triggers: 5xx rate > 1% over 5m OR KV-cache miss ratio spike > 20% triggers automatic rollback to the prior helm release (we use helmfile with release pins).
- Test matrix: terratest network connectivity (control-plane <-> worker), kube-proxy e2e smoke, and a low-latency perf probe. These run in our ephemeral canary environment and must pass before a full rollout.
- Artifact signing: we use in-repo GPG for plan signing and a key rotation policy. If Acme will host an S3 bucket for artifacts, we prefer using object locks with versioning enabled.

Sabrina — can your team confirm whether you will host artifacts or prefer Redwood to host signed artifacts to the joint bucket? If you host, please share the ARN and the minimal write role we can assume. We also need the subnet IDs for the canary pair before we cut the first PR.

Laura Bennett
Engineering Manager, Cloud Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Thanks Laura & Karthik —

We can host the artifact bucket under AcmeCloud. Iʼll have infra create a bucket with versioning + object-lock and provide a write-only role for your build account. Iʼm attaching the SOC2 evidence bundle we referenced earlier; a couple items there will map to your requested artifacts.

Canary subnet ids: subnet-az1-0a9, subnet-az1-0b3.
Ports: outbound 443 allowed; control-plane needs 5222 open to the management subnet (we can whitelist your provided egress IPs).

Iʼm available for the Tuesday 10:30am PT slot — meeting invite sent. I will also share the IAM role and the initial bucket ARN by EOD today.

Sabrina

Great sync today — notes and immediate next steps below. Iʼm dropping this into the PR checklist so the CI gating enforces the items we discussed.

Action items (owners & dates):
- Karthik: push initial repo draft (infra/priv-onprem) + sample values.priv.yaml (due: 2027-08-25) — DONE, PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482
- Laura: add terratest matrix and pipeline job (due: 2027-08-27) — ON TRACK
- Vivek: provide GPG key metadata and signing instructions to Acme (due: 2027-08-27) — ON TRACK
- Sabrina/Acme: provide writer ARN for artifact bucket (due: 2027-08-26) — PENDING (Sabrina said EOD today)

Rollforward & rollback summary: PRs will target the canary namespace first. Successful canary CI run publishes a signed manifest and a promotion job triggers the staged rollout. Failure in the gate triggers an automatic rollback to the prior pinned helm release. We will keep a 30m manual hold window before full rollout to allow your SRE to inspect metrics.

Evidence package to attach after a successful canary: terraform-plan.json (plan), manifest.yaml, manifest.sig, ci-run-id, terratest-report.html, and an attestation.txt signed by the infra lead. I have included the terraform-plan-segmentation.diff in the PR for quick review.

If we donʼt receive the ARN by EOD tomorrow we will fallback to Redwood-hosted signed artifacts (temp bucket) and update ACLs later; note that will add an hour to the onboarding timeline.

Thanks — Iʼll mark the PR with the gating checklist and tag your ops account for the first canary deploy.

Karthik
